fluff.overview: Lyran infantry draw confidence from knowing their equipment is first-rate, even when assigned to garrison duty on worlds far from the front lines. Mechanized wheeled platoons use wheeled APCs that offer a balance between the speed of hover transport and the protection of tracked vehicles, well-suited to operations on developed road networks. Armed with assault rifles and infantry-portable short-range missile launchers, these platoons carry enough anti-armor punch to threaten light vehicles and BattleMechs at close range.
